summary: Research internship under faculty at IITs, IISc, IISERs and IIITs for NPTEL Elite-Gold certified learners; invitations go out in October.
eligibility: NPTEL course toppers with an Elite-Gold certificate from the January–April semester; the course instructor decides.
title: NPTEL Winter Internship 2026-27

prize.description: In-person stipend of ₹7,500 for 2 weeks and ₹15,000 for 4 weeks; virtual internships are unpaid.

notes: By invitation: NPTEL emails eligible learners after the instructor agrees, so check your email for an October notice.
